title: Something rotten in Scandinavia: The world's earliest evidence of fermentation
version: Journal of Archaeological Science 66, 169–180, DOI 10.1016/j.jas.2016.01.008; rendered published article text
lineage: Original excavation and faunal account. The 2021 follow-up shares the lead author and assemblage, with new isotope measurements for fish provenance rather than a test of the fermentation process.

passages.note: Documents a gutter-shaped pit with adjacent stakeholes, a concentration dominated by cyprinids and collapsed pike vertebrae observed in the gutter assemblage.
Uses comparative analogies and the assemblage to infer fermentation; explicitly considers other depositional explanations.
